definitions.name: def-support
definitions.canonical: The unique original neighbor of a degree-one leaf.

definitions.name: def-h
definitions.canonical: Original deletion set {v,s_v}; the retained graph is its complement.

definitions.name: def-r
definitions.canonical: Original closed neighborhood N_T[s_v] as a deletion set.

definitions.name: def-delta
definitions.canonical: Integer forward difference of zero-extended independent-set counts in an original-graph vertex deletion.

definitions.name: def-crossing
definitions.canonical: First natural rank with strictly negative full-tree forward difference.

definitions.name: def-selector
definitions.canonical: Strict original single-vertex-deletion difference at p is negative.

definitions.name: def-aggregate
definitions.canonical: Sum over original leaves passing the strict selector, each counted separately, of the original H/R difference at p-1.

definitions.name: def-alpha
definitions.canonical: Maximum cardinality of an independent set of T.

hypotheses.canonical: First conjunct: T.IsTree, original leaf v, p>=3, |V|=2p+2, crossingIndex T+2<=p. No alpha or favorable-selector assumption.
Second conjunct: T.IsTree, |V|=2p+2, crossingIndex T+2<=p and STRICT 3p<2*indepNum(T)+1. No extra selected-leaf premise.

conclusion.canonical: Conjunction of the original-leaf integer H/R term being nonpositive under hyp-pointwise and the exact fixed-selector aggregate being nonpositive under hyp-aggregate.
clauses: Conjunction of the original-leaf integer H/R term being nonpositive under hyp-pointwise and the exact fixed-selector aggregate being nonpositive under hyp-aggregate.

theorem_contract.lean_statement:
theorem firstShellPointwiseAndAggregate :
    (∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj]
      (v : V) (p : ℕ),
      T.IsTree → C4LA1.IsGraphLeaf T v → 3 ≤ p →
      Fintype.card V = 2 * p + 2 →
      C5LA1.crossingIndex T + 2 ≤ p →
      C5LA1.forwardDifferenceDel T (C5LA1.H T v) (p - 1) -
        C5LA1.forwardDifferenceDel T (C5LA1.R T v) (p - 1) ≤ 0) ∧
    (∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj] (p : ℕ),
      T.IsTree → Fintype.card V = 2 * p + 2 →
      C5LA1.crossingIndex T + 2 ≤ p →
      3 * p < 2 * T.indepNum + 1 → C5LA1.aggregate T p ≤ 0)
